description: This file contains Linux kernel driver code for managing TMU (Traffic Management Unit) features of a specific Ethernet hardware component (sf_dpns_tmu). It includes functions for reading, writing, and configuring hardware registers related to port, queue, scheduler, and shaper settings, as well as initialization and reset routines for the TMU.

methods.name: u32 tmu_rm32(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 reg,u32 mask,u32 shift)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit register with masking and shifting.

methods.name: void tmu_rmw32(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 reg,u32 mask,u32 shift,u32 val)
methods.description: Performs a read-modify-write operation on a 32-bit register.

methods.name: int is_valid_port_idx(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port)
methods.description: Checks if a port index is valid.

methods.name: int is_valid_queue_idx(u32 q)
methods.description: Checks if a queue index is valid.

methods.name: int is_valid_sched_idx(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 sched)
methods.description: Checks if a scheduler index is valid.

methods.name: int is_valid_shaper_idx(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 shaper)
methods.description: Checks if a shaper index is valid.

methods.name: int tmu_port_writel(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 reg,u32 val)
methods.description: Writes a value to a port register.

methods.name: int tmu_port_rm32(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 reg,u32 mask,u32 shift,u32 * val)
methods.description: Reads a masked 32-bit value from a port register.

methods.name: int tmu_port_rmw32(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 reg,u32 mask,u32 shift,u32 val)
methods.description: Performs a read-modify-write on a port register.

methods.name: int tmu_queue_writel(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 queue,u32 reg,u32 val)
methods.description: Writes a value to a queue register.

methods.name: int tmu_sched_writel(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 sched,u32 reg,u32 val)
methods.description: Writes a value to a scheduler register.

methods.name: int tmu_shaper_writel(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 shaper,u32 reg,u32 val)
methods.description: Writes a value to a shaper register.

methods.name: int tmu_shaper_rmw32(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 shaper,u32 reg,u32 mask,u32 shift,u32 val)
methods.description: Performs a read-modify-write on a shaper register.

methods.name: int tdq_ctrl_is_configurable(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port)
methods.description: Checks if the port's TDAQ control is configurable.

methods.name: void tmu_port_queue_cfg(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port)
methods.description: Configures queue parameters for a port.

methods.name: void tmu_port_sched_cfg(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port)
methods.description: Configures scheduler parameters for a port.

methods.name: void tmu_port_shaper_cfg(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port)
methods.description: Configures shaper parameters for a port.

methods.name: void _tmu_reset(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port)
methods.description: Performs reset/configuration on a specific port.

methods.name: int tmu_reset(struct dpns_priv * priv)
methods.description: Resets all ports managed by the TMU.

methods.name: int dpns_tmu_init(struct dpns_priv * priv)
methods.description: Initializes the TMU hardware, performing reset and setup.
